admin_network.description:
The resource name of the multicast admin VPC network.
Use the following format:
'projects/{project}/locations/global/networks/{network}'.
admin_network.rationale: This argument references the multicast admin VPC network associated with the domain. It identifies a related network resource rather than defining a generic platform-level security control.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Controls whether Terraform can destroy the resource. A generic policy can require PREVENT to reduce the risk of accidental or unauthorised deletion and protect resource availability.

description.description: An optional text description of the multicast domain.
description.rationale: Provides human-readable metadata only and does not directly affect access control, network exposure, authentication, encryption, logging, or another security control.

labels.description:
Labels as key-value pairs.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are primarily resource metadata used for organisation and management. Appropriate label keys and values depend on organisational conventions and do not directly secure the multicast domain.

location.description: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

multicast_domain_group.description:
The multicast domain group this domain should be associated with.
Use the following format:
'projects/{project}/locations/global/multicastDomainGroups/{multicast_domain_group}'.
multicast_domain_group.rationale: This argument references a multicast domain group resource. It identifies an associated resource rather than defining a generic security control on the multicast domain.

multicast_domain_id.description:
A unique name for the multicast domain.
The name is restricted to letters, numbers, and hyphen, with the first
character a letter, and the last a letter or a number. The name must not
exceed 48 characters.
multicast_domain_id.rationale: This argument is only the resource identifier. The provider enforces its naming constraints, and the specific identifier does not provide a generic security control.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: This argument identifies the GCP project that contains the resource. Project identifiers are resource ownership references and are not treated as generic platform-level security policy targets.

connection_config.connection_type.description:
The VPC connection type.
Possible values:
NCC
SAME_VPC
connection_config.connection_type.rationale: This argument selects the functional VPC connectivity architecture between NCC and SAME_VPC. It is an operational design choice rather than a generic platform-level security control.

connection_config.ncc_hub.description:
The resource name of the
[NCC](https://cloud.google.com/network-connectivity-center) hub.
Use the following format:
'projects/{project}/locations/global/hubs/{hub}'.
connection_config.ncc_hub.rationale: This argument references an NCC hub resource used by the selected connectivity architecture. It identifies a related network resource rather than defining a generic security control.

ull_multicast_domain.description: Information for an Ultra-Low-Latency multicast domain.

ull_multicast_domain.preconfigured_ull_d.rationale: This argument identifies a preconfigured Ultra-Low-Latency multicast domain. It is a functional resource selection rather than a generic platform-level security control.
